item.echoes_in_ink.workshop_broom.desc: A broad broom left behind for clearing an abandoned printshop.
item.echoes_in_ink.workshop_broom.purpos: Optional cleanup tool: use it on cobwebs. It does not replace the Printer's Brush for investigation.
item.echoes_in_ink.printers_brush.desc: Clean dust from historical debris and furniture.
item.echoes_in_ink.printers_brush.purpos: Required for investigation: hold use on dusty workshop objects until fully cleaned.
item.echoes_in_ink.printers_brush.cleane: The dust lifts. Something of the past remains.
item.echoes_in_ink.magnifying_lens.desc: Inspect recoverable objects for hidden details.
item.echoes_in_ink.magnifying_lens.purpo: Investigation aid: identifies suspicious objects; the brush recovers their contents.
item.echoes_in_ink.magnifying_lens.look_: Hold use: look through the glass
item.echoes_in_ink.magnifying_lens.inspe: Use on a block: inspect details
Lens: laid archive paper — edges still crisp enough to print.
Lens: bold type set for a workshop notice.
item.echoes_in_ink.archive_page.place_hi: Use on a top surface to lay the page down
block.echoes_in_ink.laid_paper.blank_hin: Blank paper — ready for the press.
Lens: layered ash and broken type shards. Recoverable.
Lens: a carved wooden matrix — symbols still legible.
Lens: faded spines and a scent of old glue.
Lens: ink stains and tool marks from hurried work.
Lens: a broken press frame. Parts may still be usable.
Lens: a surface ink stain; these boards are structurally sound.
Lens: fine dust moves along a loose seam.
Lens: repeated pry marks outline a concealed floor compartment.

Lens: nothing unusual under closer look.
item.echoes_in_ink.charcoal_rubbing_pape: Optional tool material: use on a Carved Wooden Matrix block to create a printable rubbing.
Nothing here can be rubbed clearly.
item.echoes_in_ink.charcoal_rubbing.desc: A charcoal copy of a carved pattern.
item.echoes_in_ink.charcoal_rubbing.purp: Reusable press matrix: combine with blank paper and an Ink Pad to print a map fragment.
item.echoes_in_ink.blank_archive_page.de: Clean paper ready for the press.
item.echoes_in_ink.blank_archive_page.pu: Printing input: consumed by instructions, posters, maps, chronicles, and specialist prints.
Fragments of text survive under the stains.
Starter printing input: print it with the Wooden Matrix and Ink Ball to restore the chronicle.
item.echoes_in_ink.ink_ball.desc: A pad of ink for the printing matrix.
item.echoes_in_ink.ink_ball.purpose: Consumable press input: one Ink Ball is used for each impression.
item.echoes_in_ink.ink_pad.purpose: Consumable specialist ink: one pad item is used for each compatible impression.
item.echoes_in_ink.wooden_printing_matri: Carved wood form for a single design.
Required starter matrix: reusable in the press for instructions and the Restored Chronicle Page.
item.echoes_in_ink.metal_type_piece.desc: A locked chase of cast type, arranged as a reusable printing matrix.
item.echoes_in_ink.metal_type_piece.purp: Optional reusable matrix: prints warning posters with blank paper and either ink tool.
item.echoes_in_ink.upper_matrix_fragment: The carved upper half of a larger village chronicle block.
Specialist crafting part: required for the Village Chronicle Matrix recipe.
item.echoes_in_ink.lower_matrix_fragment: The carved lower half of a larger village chronicle block.
Specialist crafting part: required for the Village Chronicle Matrix recipe.
item.echoes_in_ink.missing_letter_insert: A small carved insert that completes a broken line of text.
Specialist crafting part: completes the Village Chronicle Matrix.
item.echoes_in_ink.village_chronicle_mat: A restored multi-part woodblock for village chronicles.
Reusable specialist matrix: prints Village Chronicle Prints with blank paper and an Ink Ball.
item.echoes_in_ink.lead_type_set.desc: Sorted cast letters awaiting a chase.
item.echoes_in_ink.lead_type_set.purpose: Specialist crafting part: required for the Forbidden Notice Metal Forme.
item.echoes_in_ink.iron_chase.desc: A rigid frame for locking composed metal type.
item.echoes_in_ink.iron_chase.purpose: Specialist crafting part: frame for the Forbidden Notice Metal Forme.
item.echoes_in_ink.missing_headline_type: The large letters missing from a clandestine notice.
Specialist crafting part: restores the notice headline.
item.echoes_in_ink.printers_notes.desc: Assembly marks, corrections, and a forme locking order.
item.echoes_in_ink.printers_notes.purpos: Specialist crafting part and archive clue: required to lock the Forbidden Notice Forme.
item.echoes_in_ink.forbidden_notice_form: A completed chase for printing a prohibited notice.
Reusable specialist matrix: prints Forbidden Notices with blank paper and an Ink Pad.
item.echoes_in_ink.press_screw.desc: The vertical screw of a historical press.
item.echoes_in_ink.press_screw.purpose: Required press component: use it on an incomplete Historical Screw Printing Press.
item.echoes_in_ink.press_handle.desc: Lever used to turn the press screw.
item.echoes_in_ink.press_handle.purpose: Required press component: install it on the press to make impressions.
item.echoes_in_ink.press_platen.desc: Flat plate that presses paper against the matrix.
item.echoes_in_ink.press_platen.purpose: Required press component: install it on the press above the carriage.
item.echoes_in_ink.press_carriage.desc: Sliding bed that carries matrix and paper.
item.echoes_in_ink.press_carriage.purpos: Required press component: install it to load matrix, ink, and paper.
item.echoes_in_ink.restored_chronicle_pa: A reconstructed historical page. Use it to decode location clues.
Mandatory printed milestone: produced only by the press, never by generic loot.
Use: read the next chronicle clue (server).
block.echoes_in_ink.printing_debris.desc: Dusty press fragments and discarded type from a ruined workshop.
block.echoes_in_ink.printing_debris.purp: Investigation location: inspect with the lens and clean with the brush; placed copies retain spent state.
block.echoes_in_ink.carved_wooden_matrix: A fixed carved block used by historical printers.
Optional rubbing target: use Charcoal Rubbing Paper on it; this block is not a press component.
block.echoes_in_ink.dusty_printing_table: A worktable covered with ink residue and carving marks.
Meaningful investigation location: starter workshops hide the Wooden Printing Matrix here.
block.echoes_in_ink.damaged_archive_shel: A broken shelf containing papers and catalog remnants.
Meaningful investigation location: recovers starter paper or later archive material.
block.echoes_in_ink.press_frame.desc: The remaining frame of a historical screw press.
block.echoes_in_ink.press_frame.purpose: Critical investigation location: recovers required press machinery before the first press run.
block.echoes_in_ink.collapsed_type_cabin: A toppled cabinet of type drawers and dried ink tools.
Meaningful investigation location: supplies starter ink or later metal-type material.
block.echoes_in_ink.ink_stained_floorboa: Ordinary workshop boards permanently stained by ink.
Decoration only: these boards are not suspicious and contain no investigation reward.
block.echoes_in_ink.loose_ink_stained_fl: A subtly raised floorboard with dust moving along its seam.
Optional investigation location: use the lens to confirm it, then clean it with the brush.
block.echoes_in_ink.hidden_floor_compart: A deliberately concealed cache beneath the workshop floor.
Critical starter investigation location: recovers the Press Handle before the first press run.
block.echoes_in_ink.faded_workshop_plaqu: A thin, brass-rimmed printer's maker plaque mounted near the entrance.
Required clue: inspect with the lens, then hold use with the Printer's Brush twice. It yields instructions and a map fragment.
Inspect with the Magnifying Lens, then hold use with the Printer's Brush twice to clean the plaque.

investigation.echoes_in_ink.already_sear: This has already been fully searched.

investigation.echoes_in_ink.plaque_inspe: Plaque inspected — hold the Printer's Brush twice to clean it.
investigation.echoes_in_ink.starter_rewa: A marked workshop location yields a required recovery item.

investigation.echoes_in_ink.later_reward: You recover specialist printing material from this workshop.

block.echoes_in_ink.printing_press.desc: The wooden controller block for a manually assembled historical press.

item.echoes_in_ink.printers_instruction_: How to load matrix, ink, paper, and pull the handle.
Starter guide: use it to read the complete physical press sequence.
item.echoes_in_ink.workshop_map_fragment: A printed scrap pointing toward another historical site.
Story clue: read it for directions; it is not consumed by press assembly.
item.echoes_in_ink.decorative_woodcut.de: A simple ornamental print from a wooden matrix.
item.echoes_in_ink.decorative_woodcut.pu: Optional finished print: readable and placeable as workshop decoration.

Optional finished print: read it, lay it on a surface, or hang it on a wall.
print.echoes_in_ink.printers_instruction: 1. Seat the matrix on the carriage bed.
2. Charge the form with ink ball or pad.
3. Lay clean or damaged archive paper.
4. Push the carriage, pull the handle, wait.
5. Withdraw the carriage and take the print. Empty hand + sneak removes the form.
print.echoes_in_ink.workshop_map_fragmen: Fragment of a survey map — charcoal and ink.
A second archive is marked beyond the workshop grounds.
Look for temperate woods and soft earth.
The restored chronicle will sharpen the path.
print.echoes_in_ink.decorative_woodcut.l: An ornamental woodcut: oak leaves around a press screw.
No text — only the craft of the block cutter.
Suitable for framing above a workbench.
print.echoes_in_ink.printed_warning_post: Keep hands clear of the screw and platen.
Do not leave charged ink forms overnight.
Report any seized carriage to the master printer.
By order of the workshop — hang where all may see.

print.echoes_in_ink.village_chronicle_pr: The mill bell rang before dawn.
Three bundles of pages left by the east road.
The carver marked another timber workshop upstream.
A leaf-and-screw sign hangs above its side door.
print.echoes_in_ink.forbidden_notice_pri: The clandestine printers kept a second chase.
It was sealed behind the burned rear wall.
Follow the charcoal hand, not the blocked doorway.
Do not surrender the archive to the guild censor.
